set.body:
Scope:
Ratify one ADR for the request-compile-resolve architecture and land the current compositional Slurm and durable-artifact baseline before widening submission APIs.

Acceptance criteria:
- The ADR contains the final ownership table, dependency diagram, submission flow, borrow/adapt/defer decisions, and explicit non-goals.
- SCOMP.6 is closed through its own acceptance criteria; this issue does not restate or weaken them.
- The current Slurm batch path retains one managed lifecycle authority and one verified result/output attachment path.
- Slurm pools remain explicitly unsupported until SOJ.R4 rather than being partially implemented against the old site-wide default-resource model.
- The current source state is committed coherently in each affected repository and the Sojourn scala-slurm pin names the verified upstream state.
- Focused artifact/lifecycle suites, repository-wide compile/test/format gates, codec golden fixtures, and diff checks pass.
- S3 is linked in the ADR as the sole authority for external Slurm-controller acceptance evidence; no duplicate live-cluster issue is created.
set.title: SOJ.R0: Ratify the roadmap seam and stabilize the current foundation
